newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit closes lower on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit closes lower on dollar short-covering.

text.p: Short-covering on dollar positions pulled the ringgit to a lower local close, dealers said. Trading was generally slow.
A morning push by offshore banks to drive down the dollar/ringgit below 2.50 was met by large Malaysian banks at around 2.4995, to reverse the movement.
"People who went short (on dollar/ringgit) were covering after that," said a Singapore-based bank dealer.
At 0900 GMT, ringgit was at 2.5015/25 a dollar against 2.5002/12 on Monday.
In the money market, interbank rates were slightly firmer, with the one-month rate at 7.20/22 percent from 7.15/20. -- Reme Ahmad (603-201 4813)
